steps.name: And  the user selects the "Half Sleeves" filter under Sleeve Length
Then  the page should display "8 Items" as per the applied filters
When  the user sorts products by price low to high
When  the user clicks on the first product in the list
And  the user captures and prints product details to console
And  the user clicks on "ADD TO CART" button
Then  the product should be successfully added to the cart
